items.title: Personalizing travel at scale with OpenAI
items.summary: By integrating its data systems with OpenAI’s LLMs, Booking.com delivers smarter search, faster support, and intent-driven travel experiences.
items.summaryZh: 知名旅游平台Booking.com通过将自身数据系统与OpenAI的大语言模型相集成，实现了规模化的旅游个性化定制服务。该应用提供了更智能的搜索、更快速的支持以及基于用户意图的旅游体验，展示了大模型在垂直电商领域的深度落地应用。

items.title: Introducing next-generation audio models in the API
items.summary: For the first time, developers can also instruct the text-to-speech model to speak in a specific way—for example, “talk like a sympathetic customer service agent”—unlocking a new level of customization for voice agents.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI在API中正式引入了新一代音频模型，开发者首次可以通过指令精准控制文本到语音模型的说话风格，例如模拟同理心客服等特定语气。这一特性大幅提升了语音Agent的定制化水平和自然交互体验，拓展了对话式AI的应用场景。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI在API中引入新一代音频模型并支持语音风格微调，对语音Agent和交互体验有重大影响。
